decisions.M1: Do not trust a caller-supplied union for ENDED. evaluate_endedness must rebuild (or byte-for-byte re-derive) the union from the frozen, parent-captured histories it is given, using the pinned v4 builder, and compare; a CLOSED report containing any unknown incarnation is HELD. Self-reported version/digest fields are informational only.
decisions.M2: Census logs must come only from the module factory bound to the current evaluation transaction (unforgeable token held privately), with immutable snapshot records; validate schema, counts, observer coverage and per-row digests before any process evaluation; any inconsistency HELD.
decisions.M3: Require a complete baseline witness preceding every supervisor spawn in each history; missing/inconsistent chronology HELD; window rule must be equality with the recorded baseline set, not inclusion.
decisions.M4: Bracket every native acquisition (each of the five in _identify, observer identification, library binding, fill-list calls) with the ORIGINAL deadline predicate on both success and failure paths, including the read_bytes BaseException branch, preserving primary exceptions.
decisions.M5: Final deadline check after complete result construction and canonical hashing; failure -> HELD with E_DEADLINE.
decisions.M6: Result assembly and hashing inside an ordinary-exception boundary with a safe HELD fallback (e.g. NaN observed_at_mono); separate BaseException path retains evidence.
decisions.m7: Sticky check validates raw_acquisitions/overflow enumerability and fires U_UNKNOWN_INCARNATION when unknowns cannot be excluded.
decisions.m8: Journal attempt start before acquisition; retain bounded partial evidence and completion/abort status on unwind.
decisions.m9: Split C36 into duplicate vs distinct-driver fixtures with exact causes; derive N01 complete ordered causes (incl. E_GROUP_NONEMPTY).

deliver: Design freeze v4 BEFORE code (repair map finding->change), new parent_release_identity_v4.py, exact v3->v4 diff, controls v4 (frozen expectations), disposition v4, review prompt <220000 B with full v4 source + diff + controls + design notes; notify ParentCallerCP1 of API changes (expected: evaluate_endedness signature takes histories, not a union). No execution/import/compile/tests; all files x; checkpoints <=1800 s; park.
